safe_claim: For the bounded Engram-connected [[0,3]] prefill fixture, Boundary13a constructs a source-lifetime-equivalent native persistent-state container from the same connected execution that produces the current prefill logits. Every official-model state field required across Transformer.forward calls is either represented by its source-visible prefill-end value or explicitly classified as persistent storage whose previous bytes are overwritten before the first decode read. Per-call h, pre_mix, main_hiddens, candidates, topk indices, and shared-attention handoff values are not promoted into cross-call semantic state. The resulting bounded snapshot is sufficient to define, but does not execute, the deterministic first incremental input [[15]] at start_pos=2.
